analogy.rationale: No phosphofructokinase inhibitor is present in the reference list, and PFK inhibition primarily perturbs glycolytic flux, a metabolic effect that these cell lines may buffer; the closest listed metabolic or growth-linked classes are expected to show only weak transcriptional similarity.
